text_blocks.snippet: The best contract lifecycle management (CLM) software varies by company size and complexity, with top enterprise and mid-market platforms like Ironclad, DocuSign CLM, and Agiloft leading the market.

list.snippet: Ironclad: Best for enterprise legal teams managing high-volume, complex contract workflows with advanced AI capabilities.
DocuSign CLM: Best for organizations wanting a seamless transition from electronic signatures to full document generation, negotiation, and tracking.
Agiloft: Best for organizations that need a highly customizable, no-code platform to adapt to unique, complex contract processes.
Conga CLM: Best for connecting contract cycles directly with enterprise systems like Salesforce CRM, CPQ, and ERP platforms.
Malbek CLM: Best for an intuitive, AI-fueled experience that lets sales, finance, and legal collaborate easily across departments.

list.snippet: Your company size (small business, mid-market, or enterprise)
